name: Questing Beast

abilities.text: ~ can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
Combat damage that would be dealt by creatures you control can't be prevented.
Whenever ~ deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls.

notes: The evasion line is the combat-restr family's `cant-be-blocked-by` static (a `self-keywords` with an empty keyword list has zero magnitude and claims no line). "That much damage" is `{ count: "that-many" }`, the amount the combat-damage trigger was about (TriggerCtx.amount). APPROXIMATION: the planeswalker target is narrowed to one an opponent controls rather than to the specific player who was dealt the damage; no target spec can name "that player".

issues: Whenever Questing Beast deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls. — expected The only legal targets are planeswalkers controlled by the specific opponent who was just dealt combat damage. — scripted target {kind:'planeswalker', controller:'opponent'} — any opponent's planeswalker is a legal target. Exact in 2 seats; wrong in the 4-seat games the sandbox runs (damage player B, ping player C's planeswalker). The script's notes admit no target spec can say 'that player'. — CR 109.5, 601.2c

Vigilance, deathtouch, haste / can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less / combat damage ... can't be prevented — expected three separate clauses — scripted keywords[] + cant-be-blocked-by{powerLE:2} + unpreventable-damage{filter Creature, who:'you', combat:'combat'} — all three correctly expressed; 6/6 blind scenarios pass. — CR 702.20b, 509.1b, 615.6

Whenever Questing Beast deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls. — expected The planeswalker must be one controlled by THAT player — the opponent who was just dealt the damage. — scripted target {kind:'planeswalker', controller:'opponent'} — any opponent's planeswalker is a legal target. In a multiplayer game you may hit a planeswalker belonging to a player who took no damage. The script's notes admit no target spec can say 'that player'. — CR CR 109.5, 601.2c

Whenever Questing Beast deals combat damage to an opponent — expected Trigger condition restricted to an opponent. — scripted event {on:'combat-damage-player', self:true} — game.ts:2271 fires for combat damage to ANY player, including yourself (e.g. after a control-change or a damage redirection); equivalent only in the two-player case. — CR CR 603.2

it deals that much damage / can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less / combat damage can't be prevented — expected damage equal to the combat damage dealt; blocking restriction by power; unpreventable combat damage from your creatures. — scripted amount {count:'that-many'} (fed by queueTriggers('combat-damage-player', {amount:d.n}) at game.ts:2493), cant-be-blocked-by {powerLE:2}, unpreventable-damage {filter creature, who you, combat} — all correct.
